_meta.note: REST GetFills Fill schema. Carries BOTH identity spellings (trade_id documented as 'legacy field name, same as fill_id') and BOTH ticker spellings (market_ticker documented as 'legacy field name, same as ticker') - the exact inverse of the WS user-fills message (fill.json), which has neither fill_id nor ticker. side is the deprecated legacy direction vocabulary; outcome_side/book_side are canonical. exchange_index (2026-08-30, issue #251, Trade API 3.29.0) is now a required field of this schema (get-fills.md:194) - value is the ExchangeIndex schema's own generic example (get-fills.md:316: example: 0).
